title: Wembley points the way back.
deck: A 3–0 play-off final win over Port Vale.
body: Albion’s 1993 play-off final victory over Port Vale lifted the club out of the third tier. It followed a memorable semi-final against Swansea and gave supporters a Wembley success in a difficult period of the club’s history.

Ossie Ardiles’ side offered a new set of names to remember, including Bob Taylor, Andy Hunt, Ian Hamilton and Kevin Donovan. The club later marked the occasion’s 25th anniversary with the full match and a book of interviews, preserving the season as more than a single scoreline.
